drivingQuestion: Is a round eye unnatural for an animal?
outcomeNote: Rav Yosef distinguishes black and white of the eye

segments.he: אִם נְקֵבָה — תֵּשֵׁב לִנְקֵבָה, אֵינוֹ יָדוּעַ — תֵּשֵׁב לְזָכָר וְלִנְקֵבָה, דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי מֵאִיר.
segments.en: «If» it is «female,» the woman «observes» the periods of impurity, i.e., fourteen days, and purity, i.e., sixty-six days, established in the Torah «for» a woman who gives birth to «a female.» If its sex «is unknown,» the woman «observes» the more severe restrictions from the case of the birth «of a male and» the more severe restrictions from the case of the birth «of a female:» She is impure for fourteen days like a woman who gave birth to a female, but blood that she sees thereafter is pure until only forty days after birth, like a woman who gave birth to a male. This is «the statement of Rabbi Meir.»

segments.he: וְאָמַר רַבָּה בַּר בַּר חָנָה אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן: מַאי טַעְמֵיהּ דְּרַבִּי מֵאִיר? הוֹאִיל וְגַלְגַּל עֵינוֹ עָגוֹל כְּשֶׁל אָדָם! אָמַר רַב יוֹסֵף: לָא קַשְׁיָא, הָא בְּאוּכָּמָא, הָא בְּחִיוָּורָא.
segments.en: «And Rabba bar bar Ḥana says» that «Rabbi Yoḥanan says: What is the reason of Rabbi Meir? Since the eye» of these animals «is round like» that «of a person,» a woman who miscarries a fetus of this kind is impure. «Rav Yosef said» in resolution of this apparent contradiction: It is «not difficult; this» is referring «to the black» portion of the eye, whereas «that» is referring «to the white» portion of the eye.
